# SplitPaneOrientation

`Flare.Components.SplitPaneOrientation`

Layout axis of a FlareSplitPane.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Horizontal` | `0` | Panes side by side, resized along the inline axis. |
| `Vertical` | `1` | Panes stacked, resized along the block axis. |
